Paper account & risk settings

Hard strategy gates

LLYReclaim/hold above $1,168 + volume + acceptable R:R
SHOPConfirmed reclaim above $166.35
TTWOConfirmed breakout/hold above $204.75
QNTControlled breakout over day high or supported pullback; volatility acceptable
NVDA / MSFTThesis failure only against actual stop/invalidation
Crypto/futuresRequire verified data, structure, hard invalidation and risk-adjusted sizing

Import quotes or restore ledger

Paste JSON: an array of quote objects or {"quotes":[...]}. Quote fields: symbol, last_done/last/price, prev_close, high, low, timestamp. You can also import an exported ledger JSON.
